name: IDEAS For Us — Orlando
description: Grassroots environmental nonprofit running monthly Eco-Action projects across energy, water, food, waste, and ecology — renewable-energy trainings, native landscaping, and tree plantings. Meets the first Wednesday of each month.

name: Citizens' Climate Lobby — Orlando Chapter
description: Volunteer-run chapter of the national nonprofit that trains everyday people to advocate for climate policy with local community members and members of Congress.

name: City of Orlando — Office of Sustainability & Resilience
description: The city's own sustainability office, running composting programs, South Street Farm volunteer workdays, and Orlando's Community Action Plan toward 100% renewable electricity.

name: Orange County Environmental Protection Division
description: County agency coordinating shoreline cleanups, water-quality monitoring, and conservation volunteer days across Orange County's lakes and parks.

name: Southface Institute
description: Atlanta-based nonprofit advancing sustainable homes and buildings through green building education, weatherization training, and energy-efficiency retrofits across the Southeast.

name: Fresh Energy
description: Minnesota clean-energy policy nonprofit working on community solar gardens, grid modernization, and the state's transition off coal.

name: Vote Solar
description: National advocacy nonprofit pushing state-level policy to expand rooftop and community solar access, with active campaigns nationwide including in Washington, D.C.

name: Solar Oregon
description: Volunteer-powered nonprofit that has educated Oregonians about solar energy and connected homeowners to community solar co-ops since 1998.

name: AMDEE — Asociación Mexicana de Energía Eólica
description: Mexico's wind-energy industry association, promoting wind project development and representing the sector before regulators and the public since 2005.

name: The Atmospheric Fund (TAF)
description: Toronto-based climate agency funding community energy retrofits, low-carbon transportation, and building-efficiency projects across the Greater Toronto Area.

name: 10:10 Climate Action
description: UK climate charity that helped pioneer the community energy movement, backing local renewable projects and campaigning for a fair, fast transition to clean power.

name: Community Energy England
description: The voice of the UK's community energy sector, supporting hundreds of local groups running renewable generation and Community Energy Fortnight each year.

name: WWF-Brasil
description: Brazilian branch of WWF working on Amazon conservation, renewable energy policy, and reducing the country's carbon footprint.

name: Instituto Ekos Brasil
description: Reforestation and ecosystem-regeneration institute running native tree-planting projects and biodiversity programs across Brazil.

name: Fundación Vida Silvestre Argentina
description: Argentina's WWF-affiliated conservation foundation, working on renewable energy policy, reforestation, and protecting native ecosystems.

name: CADER — Cámara Argentina de Energías Renovables
description: Argentina's renewable energy industry chamber, coordinating solar and wind project development between the public and private sectors.

name: Renewable Energy Association of Nigeria (REAN)
description: Nigeria's renewable energy industry association, working toward 40% renewables in the national energy mix by 2030.

name: All On
description: Shell Foundation-backed impact investor expanding off-grid solar and clean-cooking access across underserved communities in Nigeria.

name: Fundación Renovables
description: Spanish foundation advocating for a 100% renewable energy model and energy efficiency in buildings and transport.

name: Council on Energy, Environment and Water (CEEW)
description: One of Asia's leading policy research institutions, shaping India's renewable energy, climate, and clean-air policy.

name: SELCO Foundation
description: Nonprofit deploying decentralized solar energy solutions to underserved communities across India, linking clean energy to healthcare and education access.

name: SKOLKOVO Energy Centre
description: Independent research center studying Russia's energy sector and promoting energy-efficiency technologies for industry and housing.

name: Clean Energy Council
description: Australia's peak clean-energy industry body, representing solar, wind, and battery-storage businesses and advocating for renewable jobs.

name: Institute for Climate and Sustainable Cities (iCSC)
description: Philippine think tank advancing renewable energy roadmaps and climate-resilient development for cities across the country.
